Name: Operating checking
Notes: Customer payments and most bills

Name: Fuel card holding
Notes: Optional. Prepaid fuel card balances if the card is funded ahead

Name: Accounts receivable
Notes: Freight invoices due now, net of any factoring advance

Name: Factoring reserve receivable
Notes: Part of each invoice the factor holds back until the customer pays. Skip if you do not factor

Name: Prepaid insurance
Notes: Liability, cargo and physical damage premiums paid ahead

Name: Prepaid permits and plates
Notes: Annual registration, IFTA and heavy vehicle use fees paid ahead

Name: Tractors
Notes: At cost

Name: Trailers
Notes: At cost

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Repair shop, tire and parts invoices

Name: Factoring advances
Notes: Cash advanced by the factor against open invoices. Skip if you do not factor

Name: Fuel tax payable
Notes: Fuel tax owed or credited on the quarterly fuel tax return, from the mileage report

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll register

Name: Driver settlements payable
Notes: Pay owed to owner-operators or per-mile drivers for loads delivered but not yet settled

Name: Business credit card
Notes: The payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Truck and trailer loans
Notes: Split each payment between this line and interest expense

Name: Linehaul revenue
Notes: Freight charges for loads delivered

Name: Fuel surcharge revenue
Notes: Kept apart from linehaul so you can compare it with fuel cost

Name: Accessorial revenue
Notes: Detention, layover, lumper reimbursements and other extras billed to the customer

Name: Fuel
Notes: Diesel and DEF

Name: Driver pay
Notes: Employee driver wages, or per-mile pay

Name: Owner-operator settlements
Notes: Paid to contractors. Collect a W-9 before the first payment

Name: Repairs and maintenance
Notes: Parts, labour and shop invoices by unit if you track it

Name: Factoring fees
Notes: Discount charged by the factor on each invoice. Skip if you do not factor

Name: Office wages
Notes: Dispatch and admin staff

Name: Insurance
Notes: Liability, cargo, physical damage, workers' compensation

Name: Permits licences and plates
Notes: Annual registration, operating authority, heavy vehicle use fees

Name: Software and ELD fees
Notes: Electronic logging devices, dispatch and accounting software

Name: Interest expense
Notes: Interest part of truck and trailer loan payments
